# moodle_course_section (Resource)

Manages a section in a Moodle course.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "moodle_course_section" "introduction" {
  course_id = moodle_course.example.id
  name      = "Introduction"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `course_id` (Number) The ID of the course to which this section belongs.
- `name` (String) The display name of the section.

### Optional

- `summary` (String) The summary/description of the section (HTML is supported).
- `visible` (Number) Visibility of the section (1 = visible, 0 = hidden). Default: 1.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The internal database ID of the Moodle section.
- `section` (Number) The section number (position) within the course, assigned by Moodle.
